parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description: The keyword used to query required stress testing tasks. If this parameter is specified, the system returns stress testing tasks based on the names of the stress testing tasks in the matched Elastic Algorithm Service (EAS).

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 100.

parameters.name: ServiceName
parameters.description: The name of the EAS service that corresponds to the stress testing task. For more information about how to query the service name, see [ListServices](~~412109~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eas list-benchmark-task --filter test_bench --sort example-string --order example-string --service-name test_bench_srv --status example-string --model-id example-string --request-method example-string --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eas GET /api/v2/benchmark-tasks --region cn-hangzhou --Order 'example-string' --Status 'example-string' --PageSize 10 --Filter test_bench --ServiceName test_bench_srv --PageNumber 1 --RequestMethod 'example-string' --Sort 'example-string' --ModelId 'example-string' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
